newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt pound o/n rates steady in flush market.
newsitem.headline: Egypt pound o/n rates steady in flush market.

text.p: Overnight interbank rates on the Egyptian pound were steady on Wednesday at between seven and 8-1/2 percent in a private-sector market still flush with funds, bankers said.
The bankers also said they continued to avoid one-week deals for the third day running due to the excessive liquidity.
Some said that recent price slippages in the stock market had led investors to switch their money into banks and other bankers blamed the liquidity on the lack of t-bill issues.
On Sunday, bankers quoted one-week rates at between 8-1/2 and 9-3/4 percent. Public-sector banks kept their rates at 10-1/2 percent.
